## Installation

To install the development version from GitHub, you can use the `pak` package.

```{r, eval=FALSE}
# install.packages("pak") # uncomment if needed
pak::pkg_install("OJALAB/misclassCRC")
```

## Funding

Work on this package is supported by the OPUS 27 grant no. 2024/53/B/HS4/01580, funded by the National Science Centre in Poland.

## Use of AI Tools

Some elements of the package were designed with the support of OpenAI Codex, Claude Code, and StatsClaw.
